cards.answer: Aurora is an AP mage-assassin who combines damaging spells and attacks to trigger bonus magic damage and healing. She repositions with invisibility, a backward hop, and rift crossings. Counterplay: avoid repeated hits and returning bolts, and anticipate her repositioning.
cards.counterplay: Avoid repeated hits and returning bolts, and anticipate her repositioning.

citations.quote: Name: Aurora. Official role tags: Mage, Assassin.

Aurora's basic attacks and damaging abilities inflict a stack of Spirit Abjuration, stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.
Aurora heals over time based on her Spirits.

Aurora blasts energy and recoils backward.
If Aurora touches the border, she dashes to the opposite side of it.

cards.priority_reason: Her repeated-hit damage and frequent repositioning define how enemies should approach fights.

cards.answer: Spirit Abjuration: attacks and damaging abilities apply stacks; the third hit consumes them for bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Triggering this against a champion frees a Spirit that follows Aurora and heals her over time. Counterplay: break off repeated trades before she triggers the passive.
cards.counterplay: Break off repeated trades before she triggers the passive.

cards.answer: Twofold Hex: a bolt deals magic damage and curses enemies hit. Aurora can recall bolts from cursed targets toward herself, damaging enemies along their paths; this happens automatically when the marks expire. Returning bolts deal more damage to enemies with more missing health. Counterplay: dodge the outgoing bolt and move away from return paths toward Aurora.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the outgoing bolt and move away from return paths toward Aurora.

cards.answer: Across the Veil: Aurora hops, becomes briefly invisible on landing, and gains movement speed and the ability to move through units. A champion takedown shortly after she damages that champion resets this ability's cooldown. Counterplay: anticipate her escape direction and be ready for another hop after a takedown.

cards.answer: The Weirding: Aurora fires a line blast that deals magic damage and briefly slows enemies while she recoils backward. Counterplay: sidestep the line and account for her backward movement when chasing.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the line and account for her backward movement when chasing.

citations.quote: Aurora blasts energy in a line in the target direction and recoils 250 units in the opposite direction. The blast deals magic damage to enemies hit and slows them by 80% for 1 second decaying after the first 0.15 seconds.

cards.priority_reason: The slow and recoil help her create distance while dealing damage.

cards.answer: Between Worlds: Aurora leaps and releases an expanding shockwave that deals magic damage and slows enemies. A circular rift forms: touching its border slows enemies, while Aurora can cross to the opposite side and becomes untargetable during travel. The rift closes if she leaves or dies, and she can close it early. Counterplay: avoid the shockwave, limit contact with the border, and anticipate her exit across the rift.
